notes.title: Dreams come true
notes.content: Have you ever dreamed about what it may be like to be a knowledgeable alchemist? Well dream no longer! With the release of Brewha you’ll be able to fulfill that dream. This VR game will give you access to all you need. Craft potions for patrons in order to cure different ailments. Fight off a witch and her curse. Will your dreams become reality, and will you become a great alchemist!

notes.title: Are you ready ?
notes.content: Calling all future alchemists! This new VR title from Black Banshee Studio is going to give you an awesome opportunity. In Brewha you will take the place of an alchemist for a medieval city. Using your powers fight off the dangerous witch and help save the citizens.

notes.content: Calling all future alchemists! This new VR title from Black Banshee Studio is going to give you an awesome opportunity. In Brewha you will take the place of an alchemist for a medieval city. Using your powers fight off the dangerous witch and help save the citizens.

notes.title: About the game
notes.content: Face down a witch and her curses. As an alchemist in this VR title you’ll have to hurl potions and save the citizens of the city. The witch will try to stop you, but as a powerful alchemist you can easily face her curses. Save the city and stop the witch!

notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content: Hello future alchemists! We are releasing Brew-ha soon. This VR title is a lot of fun and will have you creating potions and fulfilling orders. Each order will get you one step closer to a high score. We’ve spent a lot of time honing the game and making it fun to play. Become a great alchemist and achieve the highest score all while fighting away the witch.
